dedupe_keys.name: ine spain censo de poblacion y viviendas 2021 indicators by census section municipal housing tables and census api

description: INE publishes the results of Spain's 2021 Population and Housing Census in several open forms. A single CSV file gives a set of indicators for every census section, the smallest statistical unit: population by sex, age, nationality and education, activity and pension status, marital status, the total number of dwellings, main (usually occupied) versus non-main dwellings, tenure of main dwellings and households by size. The census section boundaries at 1 January 2021 are published as a zipped shapefile next to it. Predefined PC-Axis tables give buildings, dwellings and households for the country, regions, provinces and municipalities, and a separate series classifies dwellings by intensity of use estimated from their electricity consumption. Custom tables can be built online, and an API with documentation and an R example serves the census data as JSON. INE produces the census to count the population and dwellings. Coverage: all of Spain. Format and access: CSV, XLSX, PC-Axis, shapefile and JSON without registration; published on 30 June 2023. Licence: INE applies CC BY 4.0 to statistical information on its website unless stated otherwise. Caveats: section indicators are few and mostly shares, not full cross-tabulations; building characteristics such as age and condition are in the municipal tables. Simulation uses: population and dwelling exposure by section, vacant or seasonal dwelling shares from electricity use for energy demand, and evacuation planning. Related records: the INE 1 km population grid of the same census, the Spain hospital accessibility by census tract record and GHSL.
